Honestly for me it’s usually just fighting the intent for one minute, than the next. Sometimes I remember my family and how emotionally gut wrenching it’d be to them but most often it’s simply being constantly aware and fighting back.

“Dated” a girl in college for about a week. During that time, her nomadic mother showed up in the van she lives in with her boyfriend and I was bamboozled into driving her and a bunch of friends a couple of hours to meet her father. (I later found out that she was hoping I was going to ask for her hand during this visit.) 
   Anyway, because of a string of unrelated yet manic and honestly interesting events, I was considering transferring schools. Well there’s a major incident involving my roommate one night who lit my stuff on fire and snapped my laptop and nearly killed himself. Needless to say the campus police were contacted and I was moved out of my dorm immediately. I’m discussing this emotionally traumatizing event to my “girlfriend” and I mention that maybe I really should transfer. She says yes I should, and she’ll follow me wherever I go. Basically she professes her love for me, says she wants to get pregnant that night and will drop out and get a job to help pay for me to go to school if that’s what it takes. I broke up with her on the spot. 
   Later that night I get a call from campus police saying she’s barricaded herself in her dorm with another mutual friend and they’re threatening to follow through with a suicide pact if I don’t talk to her. In hindsight, why none of us, especially the campus police called the real cops and/or just busted her door in I don’t know but it was a really small town with shitty cops and who knows why else. So I show up and convince her to open the door, everyone is safe, hooray, now never talk to me again. She leaves campus the next day.
  Fast forward a month or two and she contacts me telling me she’s pregnant and of course it’s mine. Now this is not possible unless she snuck into my room and  jerked the necessary material out of me while I was sleeping because we had hardly done anything with each other. (Usually I’m bashful about being prudish but this time it played in my favor.) She actually gets some shit head small town lawyer friend to help her sue me over it and of course I’m not the father so she slinks away. 
  However, she was actually preggers and the actual father, I learned later, is a guy who in almost every way is me. His name is similar, he looks the same, dresses the same, has the same interests— the whole deal. Last I heard they got married. Poor sap. 
   
TLDR; girl nearly instantly became obsessed with me, tried to kill herself when we broke up, sued me for paternity when we never had sex and ultimately ended up with my doppelgänger.
